rules.effective_date_basis: The provisions of this ordinance shall take effect on January 1, 2020.
rules.title: Source-of-income discrimination in rental housing prohibited
rules.requirement: A landlord may not refuse to rent, renew, continue a tenancy, or otherwise deny housing based on a person’s source of income. A landlord also may not impose different rental terms, deposits, services, repairs, availability representations, or advertisements based on source of income.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to a “housing accommodation,” but the excerpt does not include the definition of that term.
coverage.summary: Rental housing accommodations in Los Angeles are covered with respect to source-of-income discrimination.

rules.penalty: An aggrieved person may bring a civil action for injunctive relief and damages; the court may award punitive damages of at least three times actual damages or three times one month’s rent, whichever is higher, plus reasonable attorney fees and costs. A violation may also be asserted as an affirmative defense in an unlawful detainer action.
rules.quoted_span: Based upon a person’s source of income, refuse to rent or lease, or to continue to rent or lease, a housing accommodation; refuse to enter into or renew a rental agreement, lease or housing assistance payment contract; refuse to execute any documents required to enter into or renew a rental agreement
